authority_tiers.R1: Drafting and analysis in isolated workspaces
authority_tiers.R2: Bounded sandbox testing; no production side effects
authority_tiers.R3: Explicit allowlisted controlled execution with expiry, idempotency, audit receipt and rollback
authority_tiers.R4: Human-reserved decisions; agent may assemble evidence but cannot impersonate approver

agents.name: RegenExcalibur Program Governor
agents.authority_boundary: Coordinate only; cannot approve own outputs or bypass domain review.

agents.name: Requirements and Traceability Architect
agents.authority_boundary: No requirement is verified without linked evidence.

agents.name: Built-Environment Systems Architect
agents.authority_boundary: Design support only; regulated design requires qualified human approval.

agents.name: Materials and Fabrication Engineer
agents.authority_boundary: No fabrication-ready disposition without approved calculations, drawings, BOM, QA and tests.

agents.name: Envelope and BIPV Integration Agent
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot certify code compliance, structural adequacy or electrical safety.

agents.name: Carbon and MRV Assurance Agent
agents.authority_boundary: No public quantified carbon claim without reproducible calculations and independent verification.

agents.name: Codes Permits and Regulatory Research Agent
agents.authority_boundary: Research only; does not issue legal, code or regulator approval.

agents.name: Safety Hazard and Constructability Agent
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot waive hazards or replace competent safety review.

agents.name: Lifecycle and Circularity Agent
agents.authority_boundary: Claims require source evidence and explicit assumptions.

agents.name: Supply Chain and Procurement Analyst
agents.authority_boundary: No purchase orders, vendor onboarding or commitments.

agents.name: Commercial and Finance Modeler
agents.authority_boundary: Estimates are not quotes, financing commitments or guaranteed returns.

agents.name: Research and Evidence Librarian
agents.authority_boundary: Uncited assertions and agent consensus are not proof.

agents.name: Digital Twin and Data Contract Architect
agents.authority_boundary: No authoritative design mutation without approved change control.

agents.name: Test Commissioning and Verification Planner
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot certify tests not independently observed or validated.

agents.name: Independent Design and Claims Reviewer
agents.authority_boundary: Must be independent of authoring and disclose conflicts; review is not release approval.

agents.name: Change Control and Configuration Manager
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot approve its own change or overwrite accepted baselines.

agents.name: AIGC Evidence and Provenance Verifier
agents.authority_boundary: Evidence readiness only; cannot authorize release.

agents.name: Security Privacy and Tool Permission Agent
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot grant itself permissions or disable controls.

agents.name: Audit and Retention Custodian
agents.authority_boundary: Local logs or hash chains alone do not establish independent immutable retention.

agents.name: Canonical AIGC Release Assurance Agent
agents.authority_boundary: Sole software release authority; blocks on missing or unverifiable evidence.

agents.name: Human Decision and Acceptance Gate
agents.authority_boundary: Never fabricate consent; silence and CI success are not acceptance.

agents.name: Repository Reviewer Assignment and Independence Gate
agents.responsibility: prepare reviewer qualification criteria, inspect repository reviewer/permissions metadata, and request assignment by an authorized repository administrator
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot appoint itself, fabricate reviewer credentials, request privileged access beyond policy, or treat its own review as independent.

agents.name: Independent Security Review Evidence Gate
agents.responsibility: validate that a qualified human reviewer examined the exact PR head, workflow permissions, OIDC/Sigstore adapter, trust boundaries, findings, and remediation
agents.authority_boundary: Collects and validates evidence of a review; is not the independent reviewer and cannot approve its own implementation.

agents.name: Findings Remediation and Exact-Head CI Orchestrator
agents.responsibility: track review findings to fixes, preserve required checks, run full CI on the final exact commit, and bind results to commit/tree/run/attempt
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot suppress or weaken checks, rewrite review findings as resolved without evidence, merge, or release.

agents.name: Authenticated Human Acceptance Custodian
agents.responsibility: validate authorized human acceptance bound to exact commit and evidence digest, including approver identity, scope, timestamp, and conditions
agents.authority_boundary: Never solicits consent through impersonation, fabricates acceptance, or treats CI/reviewer approval/silence as human acceptance.

agents.name: Protected Merge Readiness Gate
agents.responsibility: verify branch rules, required checks, review approvals, conversation resolution, exact PR head, and authorized merge path before a human/authorized repository process merges
agents.authority_boundary: Readiness assessment only; cannot bypass branch protection or merge unilaterally.

agents.name: Mainline OIDC and Attestation Verifier
agents.responsibility: inspect exact successful main-branch run and verify actual OIDC claims plus signed attestation repository identity, workflow identity, source SHA, predicate, and evidence subject digest
agents.authority_boundary: Must use live verifier output and authenticated claims; mocks, hashes alone, feature-branch runs, or agent assertions do not satisfy trust verification.

agents.name: Signed Evidence Artifact and Independent Audit Gate
agents.responsibility: download and inspect retained signed-evidence artifacts, recompute package digests, bind receipts to exact run/attempt/commit/digest, verify independent audit retention, and evaluate release-criteria completeness
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot claim independent retention from a same-process/local log alone and cannot authorize release; hands evidence to RX-19 for final evaluation.

agents.name: Operational Release Block and Exact-Head Gate Coordinator
agents.responsibility: coordinate authorized repository-administrator assignment of a qualified independent security reviewer; track review findings through evidenced remediation; require complete CI on the final exact commit; continuously enforce a BLOCK disposition for RX-19 until every required review, human acceptance, protected-merge, live provenance, signed-evidence, audit-retention, and release criterion is verified
agents.authority_boundary: Read-only gate coordinator. May request authorized actions and assemble evidence but cannot appoint reviewers, self-approve, close findings without evidence, alter or weaken required checks, accept on behalf of a human, bypass protections, merge, attest to unverified provenance, or override RX-19 BLOCK. Missing, stale, contradictory, unauthenticated, or wrong-commit evidence must preserve BLOCK.
